full_judgment: “8.The defence case need not be proved by examining witnesses; if some indication in their favour is available from cross-examination of the prosecution witnesses, then this may be sufficient for their acquittal. The manner of the incident as alleged by the prosecution must be proved by the prosecution alone; that burden never shifts. If the manner of the incident is not proved, the prosecution must fail no matter the defence version of the case has not been proved either.”
